parked.justification: forceApprove(newStaker, total) then per-user depositFor(amounts[i]) assumes the migrator holds exactly `total`. Under FoT it holds total-minus-fee and the final depositFor reverts. C4 treats generic fee-on-transfer as known-invalid unless explicitly in scope, and stable-staker declares no FoT tokens in scope. Project memory also records FoT as PERMANENTLY INVALID for the sibling phlimbo-ea project.
parked.recommendedDisposition: suppress under C4 known-invalid at the sanitizer tier, NOT at dedup
parked.notFiledBecause: Known-invalid suppression is the sanitizer's call, not the deduplicator's. Routed rather than pre-empted.
parked.reopenTrigger: If a fee-on-transfer or rebasing token is ever added to the supported-token set, this becomes a live brick and must be reopened.

parked.title: LAW-1 STATUS-SEMANTICS DEFECT - dab5a656 is filed 'acknowledged' but its own triageNote says WILL FIX
parked.justification: CLAUDE.md draws an explicit Law-1 distinction: 'acknowledged' = accepted and disposed of, SUPPRESSED from future scans; 'fix-pending' = accepted and a fix is OWED, NEVER suppressed. dab5a656's triageNote reads verbatim 'Owner-accepted 2026-06-09, WILL FIX.' Per CLAUDE.md, 'When a triage instruction sounds like "acknowledged, will fix", the operative word is will fix -> fix-pending.' The entry is currently 'acknowledged', i.e. SUPPRESSED, precisely while a fix is depended upon to land correctly.
parked.impact: A suppressed entry is hidden from /open-issues and excluded from future scans. Combined with DEDUP-002 (which shows the intended fix has an unowned side effect), the suppression could hide an incomplete remedy.
parked.recommendedDisposition: human review: consider /ledger stable-staker fix-pending dab5a656. NOT actioned by the deduplicator - status changes are human-only.
